Symmetry generators (signed permutations of the axes; each maps the 16 missing lines to themselves up to sign, hence ports to ports and frames to frames). Coordinate i moves to position p[i], then the listed axes change sign:

- p = [7, 5, 1, 2, 6, 3, 0, 4], sign flips on axes [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
- p = [4, 7, 2, 3, 5, 0, 1, 6], sign flips on axes [2, 3, 5, 7]
- p = [2, 3, 0, 6, 4, 5, 7, 1], sign flips on axes [1, 2]

They generate a group of order 384 on lines with three orbits on ports, of sizes 32, 48, 24, represented by p0, p22, p28.
